structured_output.commitSubject: feat: add Swift library for driving agentic CLIs
structured_output.commitDescription:
Introduces a Swift package that launches agentic CLI tools as
subprocesses and exposes their sessions through a typed Swift API,
so callers can drive them programmatically instead of shelling out
and parsing output ad hoc.

Handles process lifecycle, streaming stdout/stderr, and structured
event decoding behind a single entry point.
